Q2 FY2027: revenue $2.739B (+37% YoY, $39M above guidance midpoint); GAAP diluted EPS $0.33; non-GAAP diluted EPS $0.94; raised FY2027/FY2028 revenue outlook
catalysts.impact: beat, but stock fell >10% on valuation/expectations reset per analyst commentary

catalysts.headline: Marvell granted Google a warrant for up to 58.97M shares at $206.58 (~$12.2B fully exercised) under an expanded custom AI chip agreement covering AI inference accelerators and storage/network/memory controllers tied to Google's TPU ecosystem; full vesting tied to $120B of custom-product revenue milestones
catalysts.impact: stock +8-10%; Broadcom fell >5% on competitive concern

catalysts.headline: Marvell filed a Form 424B7 resale prospectus supplement covering 146,504 shares of common stock offered by selling securityholders (not Marvell), tied to the February 2026 acquisition of XConn Technologies Holdings, Ltd.
catalysts.impact: This is a resale/secondary registration, not a new primary equity raise — Marvell receives no proceeds and this does not represent new dilutive capital-raising. Resolves the open question in the pre-existing record: the July 2026 prospectus did not price as a capital raise.
